pages.title: Wild Yak
pages.text: The wild yak ($(o)Bos mutus$()) is a large wild bovine native to the Tibetan Plateau, where it lives in cold alpine steppe and tundra at high altitude.$(br2)It is the wild ancestor of the domestic yak, and wild bulls are much larger than domestic animals.$(br2)Its long, shaggy coat hangs almost to the ground over a dense woolly undercoat, protecting it from the extreme cold of its mountain home.
